judgments.question: Does unseen-length generalization mean representational applicability or maintained translation performance, and what evidence supports the latter?
judgments.rationale: The located text supports the architectural reading while the preserved question asks the authors to delimit any empirical performance claim. It is a specific, answerable clarification and does not allege a demonstrated error.

p3_conservatism.rationale: P3 appropriately removed the unsupported stronger interpretation and retained a narrower clarification because no length-bucket performance result was independently established.

limitations: This is a non-expert P5 review of a historical recorded-model replay, not a fresh P5 model run.
The PDF text locations were checked through the committed source mapping; formula and table visuals were not independently reverified here.
One sentinel author-facing issue was assessed; this file is not a complete-paper quality estimate.
